title: Under Pressure: Gas Laws — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Gas-law practice built on Dr. Dan's Lectures 15–16. Learn Trail (6 stops: Gas Basics, Changing Conditions, One Set of Conditions, Gas Mixtures, Gas Reactions, and Speed & Real Gases for 1A) with worked examples, guided steps and solo practice. Practice Quests with Mixed Practice, a 10-question Readiness Check with a study plan, and topic quests. Gas-law problems start with picking the right equation card (shown as fractions, no names), with feedback on which variables change. Opens on CHEM 3A (use ?course=1A for CHEM 1A). Covers units and KMT, Boyle, Charles, Gay-Lussac, Avogadro, combined and ideal gas laws, STP molar volume, molar mass and mystery gases (gas density for CHEM 1A only), Dalton's law, gas collected over water, gas stoichiometry, and for CHEM 1A RMS speed, Graham's law and van der Waals real gases. Includes hints, worked solutions, mistake detection (°C vs K, mL vs L, mmHg vs atm), sig-fig coaching, E-notation input, XP, achievements, a particle playground with a piston (He, diatomic N₂, Xe), Yellow Sheet reference and matched ItsDrDan videos.
